question: The IAAF World Championships in Athletics became a fully professional competition from _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1997**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The IAAF World Championships in Athletics became a fully professional competition from **1997**.
 
• The IAAF (International Association of Athletics Federations), now known as World Athletics, organizes these championships.
 
• These championships are a biennial event, bringing together the best athletes from around the world to compete in various track and field events.
 
• The transition to a fully professional competition marked a significant shift in the organization and promotion of the championships, elevating their status and global reach.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The IAAF World Championships in Athletics were first held in 1983 in Helsinki, Finland.
 
• World Athletics is the international governing body for the sport of athletics, which includes running, jumping, throwing, and walking events.
 
• The organization is responsible for setting the rules and regulations for international competitions and ensuring fair play and integrity in the sport.
 
• The World Championships are one of the most prestigious events in the athletics calendar, second only to the Olympic Games.
